theorems.name: Submission.cbrr_cone_claim
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a b δ : ℝ), 0 < a → b * 16 ^ n < a → (∀ y ∈ E, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → ENNReal.ofReal (a * ρ ^ n) ≤ μ (closedBall y ρ)) → (∀ x ∈ E, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → μ ({z | 2 * ‖(Q x).starProjection (z - x)‖ < ‖z - x‖} ∩ ball x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b * ρ ^ n)) → ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ y ∈ E, ‖(Q x).starProjection - T.starProjection‖ < 1 / 16 → ‖y - x‖ < δ / 2 → ‖y - x‖ ≤ 4 * ‖T.starProjection (y - x)‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
